name: guap
description: Flagship pure-Rust single-machine offline AI + human IT administration appliance federating all 10 GUAP domain suites (326 MCP tools) via 6 deterministic runbooks, a 6-meta-tool lazy MCP router, human Approval Cards, Merkle custody receipts, and dual Win32/Iced consoles.
majorCapabilities: Dynamic federation of all 10 GUAP suites (326 MCP tools across sys2rust, net2rust, forensics2rust, winctl2rust, fs2rust, chrome2rust, mail2rust, mail2mail, android2rust, robocopy2rust)
6 deterministic <200ms IT triage runbooks with GuapQuery filtering and SHA-256/512 Merkle CustodyManifest receipts
6-meta-tool (~800-token) lazy MCP gateway eliminating 326-schema context bloat
Tiered Autonomy Policy Engine: read-only tools run freely; mutating fixes require dry_run preview + SQLite Approval Card + human sign-off
Offline localhost llama-server OpenAI-compatible tool-calling agent loop (zero external API keys)
Dual zero-GPU Win32 (WinSafe) and cross-platform Iced 0.14 desktop consoles

tools.summary: Snapshot host OS, CPU/memory/storage posture, local LLM status, and discovered GUAP suites
Execute one of the 6 deterministic IT diagnostic runbooks and emit a compact digest + Merkle custody manifest
Search the 326-tool federated catalog and lazy-load 1..=5 matching JSON schemas
Invoke any read-only tool across the 10 GUAP suites with optional row/byte budget caps
Run a non-destructive dry_run preview and stage a pending human Approval Card (never mutates without explicit sign-off)
List, inspect, or stage deterministic recurring Job Profiles for local maintenance
